title: Lab - DaemonSets
scenario: Inspect and write a DaemonSet. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inventory
tasks.instructions: How many DaemonSets exist across all namespaces, and which ones?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Which node
tasks.instructions: On which nodes does the kube-proxy DaemonSet run Pods?
tasks.solution: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-proxy -o wide

tasks.title: Task 3 - Write one
tasks.instructions: Create a DaemonSet elasticsearch in kube-system with image registry.k8s.io/fluentd-elasticsearch:1.20.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create deployment elasticsearch -n kube-system --image=registry.k8s.io/fluentd-elasticsearch:1.20 --dry-run=client -o yaml > ds.yaml
# change kind to DaemonSet, drop replicas and strategy
kubectl apply -f ds.yaml
